editorial_findings_resolved: Existing breast and colorectal bodies linked by ID rather than duplicated
Blood cancers, Kaposi and mesothelioma take precedence over organ grouping; original primary retained for metastases
Six disjoint completed-year bands with pregnancy as an overlay
Physical activity versus measured function, food intake versus growth, resource conditions versus service use given separate owners
Missing air-pollution stage references restored without copying body text
BMI units and cancer abbreviations explained in both languages
Repeated hypothetical scoring disclaimers replaced with direct evidence boundaries
GLOBOCAN paper Table 1 version pinned; nonmelanoma BCC exclusion and female-only breast count stated
Arabic interface retains English-body LTR contents links
limitations: Editorial/source-location review is distinct from independent clinical sign-off
Exact text-duplicate detection supports but does not establish semantic MECE; ownership and boundaries were also read manually
Cancer knowledge units are educational registration groups, not 36 complete disease articles or measured ICD coverage
Country trends, selected trial effect sizes, rare-pathology detail and local reimbursement remain scoped future content in import audits
